spans.s:
शणं Hemp.
--Comp.
--सूत्रं {1} a
hempen cord or string. {2} a net
made of hemp. {3} cordage.

शणीरं A bank or alluvial island
in the middle of the river Śoṇa.

शाणीरं A bank or spot of ground
in the Śoṇa river.

शाण a. (णी f.) [शणेन निर्वृत्तं अण्]
Hempen, flaxen.
--णः
1 A
touchstone; मणिः शाणो ल्लीढः

.
--2 A whetstone.
--3 A
saw.
--4 A weight of four Māṣas.
--णं
1 Sack-cloth, coarse cloth.
--2 A
hempen garment;

शाणिः A plant from the fibres of
which a coarse cloth is prepared.

शाणित p. p. Whetted, ground,
sharpened (on a whetstone).

1 A touchstone.
--2 A
whetstone.
--3 A saw.
--4 A hempen
garment.
--5 A ragged garment.
--6 A
small screen or tent.
--7 Gesticulation,
a sign made with the hands or eyes.
--8 A weight of four Māṣas.

षाण्मातुरः [षड् मातरोऽस्य]
‘Having six mothers,’ an epithet of
Kārtikeya.

षाण्मासिक a. (की f.) Six
monthly, half-yearly. {2} Six months’
old; मौक्तिकानां षाण्मासिकानां

सणसूत्रं A hempen cord or
thread.
